name: EMBRYOLOGY_SPECIMEN
description: Contains information about oocyte, embryo, or sperm specimens.

columns.name: SPECIMEN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the specimen record.

columns.name: REI_SPEC_STATE_C_NAME
columns.description: The state of a specimen in an embryology or andrology lab. This tracks whether a specimen is currently in-culture, frozen, discarded, etc.

columns.name: EMB_SPEC_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of embryology specimen: oocyte, embryo, or sperm.

columns.name: EMB_SPEC_RECEIVE_CULTURE_DAY
columns.description: This item stores the number of culture days that have occurred for the specimen when it was received in the lab.

columns.name: EMB_SPEC_EXT_RETRIEVAL_DATE
columns.description: This item stores the date on which the oocyte retrieval occurred for the given embryology specimen.

columns.name: EMB_SPEC_EXTERNAL_FREEZE_DATE
columns.description: This item stores the date on which the embryology specimen was frozen.

columns.name: EMB_SPEC_EXTERNAL_COMMENTS
columns.description: This item stores relevant comments associated with the embryology specimen that came from an external lab.
